card.name: Vaginal infection treatment text
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas and numbers inside text about vaginal infections such as trichomoniasis, vaginosis and candidiasis. It fires just before a dose amount or a list of antifungal or antimicrobial drugs.

modes.example: PHEXXI may be used concomitantly with other products for vaginal infections including miconazole, metronidazole, and<< t>>ioconazole.
